The '''Ulgo Footpaths''' were a series of paths that led through the mountains of [[King's Pass]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The footpaths were largely under control of [[House Ulgo]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
